title: Present Simple
description: Use the present simple for regular actions and facts.
objectives: Use the present simple for regular actions and facts.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to use the present simple for regular actions and facts. The central language is present simple affirmative and third-person -s. It belongs to the practical context of daily life. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the present simple exchange.
This present simple model adds a different detail or response.

blocks.english: What do you do every day?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the present simple exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “I study English every day.” and “Mina works at a hospital.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: present simple affirmative and third-person -s.
